title: Apologizing
subtitle: 사과
review: Written by Claude. The Korean and the romanization have not been checked by a Korean speaker. English support only: no Burmese lines were written. Check before recording audio.

categories.desc: Three levels of sorry, and the polite 'excuse me'.
cards:
죄송합니다.

The polite, safe sorry: to strangers, to elders, at work.
I'm sorry, are you all right?

미안합니다.

Polite, and a little less formal than joesonghamnida.

미안해요.

Friendly and polite. To close friends: Mianhae.

실례합니다.

'I am being rude.' Before you interrupt, pass in front of someone or enter a room.

categories.desc: Saying what you are sorry for.
cards:
늦어서 죄송합니다.

A verb + -eoseo or -aseo: sorry because…

Neujeoseo joesonghamnida. Giri makyeosseoyo.
늦어서 죄송합니다. 길이 막혔어요.
I'm sorry I'm late. The traffic was bad.

기다리게 해서 죄송합니다.

Gidarida: to wait.

Gidarige haeseo joesonghamnida. Keopi nawatseumnida.
기다리게 해서 죄송합니다. 커피 나왔습니다.
Sorry for the wait. Here is your coffee.

제 실수예요.

Silsu: a mistake, a slip.

Joesonghamnida, je silsuyeyo.
죄송합니다, 제 실수예요.

제가 잘못했어요.

Owning up to a real fault.

Jega jalmotaesseoyo. Mianhaeyo.
제가 잘못했어요. 미안해요.
It was my fault. I'm sorry.

categories.desc: Putting the other person at ease.
cards:
괜찮아요.

The usual answer. Careful: it can also mean 'no, thank you'.

Neujeoseo mianhaeyo. — Geokjeong maseyo.
늦어서 미안해요. — 걱정 마세요.

신경 쓰지 마세요.

'Please don't let it bother you.'

Jeongmal joesonghamnida. — Singyeong sseuji maseyo.
정말 죄송합니다. — 신경 쓰지 마세요.
I'm really sorry. — Don't mind it.

저도 미안해요.

Jeodo: me too. Both sides apologize, and the matter is closed.

Mianhaeyo. — Anieyo, jeodo mianhaeyo.
미안해요. — 아니에요, 저도 미안해요.
I'm sorry. — No, I'm sorry too.
